Nutella bombolini ✨ Ingredients  Donuts - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - Canola oil for frying Filling/topping - 7.7 oz Nutella  - Granulated sugar (to cover donuts) Instructions  - In a bowl, combine warm milk and 1 tbsp sugar. Sprinkle yeast over the top, stir lightly, and let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add eggs, 1/3 cup sugar, vanilla extract and mix again until well combined. - Add flour to mixture. Mix until a rough dough forms. - Begin kneading. Once the dough starts to come together, gradually add the softened butter (1 tbsp at a time), kneading until fully incorporated before adding more. - Continue kneading 8–10 minutes by hand or 5–6 minutes in a stand mixer, until smooth, elastic, and slightly tacky. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - Punch down dough and separate into 12 balls (weighing 65g each) - Place onto parchment lined tray cover loosely and let rise 30–40 minutes, until puffy. - In a large skillet heat oil to 325–335°F (aim for 330°F) - Fry 2–3 minutes per side - Flip every 30–45 seconds for even color - Fry until golden brown - Remove donuts from oil place onto a wire rack  - Toss in sugar until fully coated - Poke a hole in the top of each donut - Pipe in Nutella filling until slightly heavy - Serve & enjoy!  • • • #Recipe #donuts #baking #bakingrecipe

Prepare the wet batter by whisking together buttermilk, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and smoked paprika. Add the chicken strips to the wet batter and marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight. 2. Prepare the dry batter by whisking together flour, cornstarch, salt, garlic powder, black pepper, and smoked paprika. 3. Remove the chicken from the wet batter, allowing excess to drip off, then coat each strip in the dry batter. 4. Deep-fry the coated chicken strips in hot oil (about 350°F) until golden brown and cooked through, approximately 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through. 5. Prepare the Cane’s Sauce by whisking together mayonnaise, ketchup,Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and smoked paprika. 6. Save this reel and let me know which one you’re making first👇 OVEN BAKED EGGPLANT DIP🍆🍅🧅🧄 Ingredients: • 1 large eggplant or 2 small eggplants, cut into large cubes • 1 onion, chopped • 1 large tomato, chopped • 2 jalapeños or 5 serrano chilies • 1 red pepper, chopped • Handful of garlic cloves, peeled Sauce: • ½ cup olive oil • ¼ cup tomato paste • ¼ cup pomegranate molasses • ¼ cup date molasses • 1 tbsp salt • 1 tbsp paprika Place all vegetables in an oven-safe dish. Mix sauce ingredients separately and pour over vegetables. Toss well. Cover and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes. Uncover, mix, and bake an additional 30 minutes. EGGPLANT VEGETABLE SALAD🍆🍅🥒🧄 Ingredients: • 1 large eggplant • 2 firm tomatoes, finely diced • 4 Persian cucumbers, finely diced • ⅓ cup olive oil • Juice of 2 lemons • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1-2 tsp salt Slice eggplant lengthwise and roast face down on a grill until soft, about 15-18 minutes total. Alternatively, roast at 425°F for about 45 minutes. Remove the flesh, roughly chop, and combine with tomatoes, cucumbers, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and salt. EGGPLANT MUSHROOM SALAD🍆🍄‍🟫🌿🧄 Ingredients: • 1 large eggplant, cubed • 4-5 mushrooms, sliced • 1 bunch cilantro or parsley, chopped • 3-4 garlic cloves, minced • ⅓ cup olive oil • Juice of 1 lemon • ¼ cup vinegar • 1-2 tsp salt Place eggplant on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Spray generously with oil and season with salt. Bake at 425°F for about 45 minutes. Cool and combine with mushrooms, herbs, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, and salt. Lemon Blueberry Fritters Dough 	•	1 cup warm milk 	•	1/4 cup sugar 	•	1/4 cup blueberries 	•	1 packet instant yeast 	•	2 eggs 	•	1 egg yolk 	•	1 tsp vanilla extract 	•	4 cups flour Filling 	•	1 cup blueberries Lemon Glaze 	•	1 cup powdered sugar 	•	2 tbsp lemon juice 	•	1/2 tsp lemon zest 	•	1/4 tsp vanilla extract Instructions In a bowl, combine the warm milk and sugar. In a separate bowl, mash the 1/4 cup blueberries, then stir them into the milk mixture. Add the yeast and let sit for 5 minutes. Add the eggs, egg yolk, and vanilla, then mix well. Stir in the flour until a dough forms. Knead for 2-3 minutes, then place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Roll the dough into a rectangle. Scatter the 1 cup of blueberries over one half of the dough, then fold the other half over the top. Cut the dough into small squares and gently toss them together. Form the dough pieces into 6 fritters by gently pressing the pieces together, dusting your hands with flour as needed. Place on a parchment lined tray, cover, and let rise for another 30 minutes. Heat oil over medium heat. Fry the fritters for about 3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate. For the glaze, whisk together the powdered sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest, and vanilla until smooth. Dip the warm fritters into the glaze to coat, then let set before serving.
